text: ドラゴンを　もういちど　きたえなおして　くるんだ！

structure.jp: ドラゴンを　もういちど
きたえなおして　くるんだ！
structure.en: I'll go retrain them and come back!

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.span: きたえなおして　くる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form verb says you go off, do the thing, and come back. きたえなおして　くる = 'go and retrain them (and come back)'.

patterns.name: 〜なおす
patterns.explanation: なおす stuck onto a verb means doing it over again, better this time. きたえなおして = 'train again from scratch'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and gives the line a firm, explaining tone, here like a decision announced. くるんだ = 'I'm going to (go and) do it!'.
